entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: These ratings're insane.[n]Haven't they gone up even more?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There seems to be no end to it.[n]People are truly enjoying this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But their dislike of Okumura[n]is starting to impact Haru...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm OK. It was shocking at first,[n]but I'm not letting it get to me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm more worried that Father will[n]try to do something drastic...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Anything is possible given the[n]state of public opinion...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well we just gotta make sure[n]nothing bad happens, yeah?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We don't have much time left![n]We hafta handle this, ASAP!
